finding: P2: selected rocket launcher and gun-arm overlay persist during the scripted crash crawl

before.review: Long green launcher crosses the prone courier and the arms remain in the carry pose.

after.review: Launcher is absent and the native crawl pose has both hands free.

method: Both runs use normal unpaused production-clock play with actual keyboard input from the crossing start. Save/scenario initialization is disclosed in the lane report. The comparison is at the first crawl frame and same zoom, not a pixel-identical HP/damage-state A/B. The before run reached zero by ordinary infected attacks; the after run retained durability. Inventory/HP/AI were not edited during either drive.
